rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for attaining a level, standard, result, or objective.

example.english: We put in a lot of effort and finally attain our goal.
example.traditional: 我哋努力咗好耐，終於達到目標喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 nou5 lik6 zo2 hou2 noi6 zung1 jyu1 daat6 dou3 muk6 biu1 laa3

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing successfully carrying out or accomplishing a task through effort.

example.english: After a month of practice, I finally attain my goal of doing a full split.
example.traditional: 我練咗成個月，終於做到一字馬喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 lin6 zo2 seng4 go3 jyut6 zung1 jyu1 zou6 dou3 jat1 zi6 maa5 laa3

rows.note: Use this especially with goals or objectives when stressing their successful completion.

example.english: With this plan, we attain our emissions-reduction target.
example.traditional: 我哋靠呢個計劃達成減排目標。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 kaau3 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 daat6 sing4 gaam2 paai4 muk6 biu1

rows.note: Use this for obtaining a concrete result, qualification, or reward through effort rather than reaching an abstract level.

example.english: Studying for six months helped me attain a professional certificate.
example.traditional: 我溫足半年，終於攞到張專業證書。
example.jyutping: ngo5 wan1 zuk1 bun3 nin4 zung1 jyu1 lo1 dou2 zoeng1 zyun1 jip6 zing3 syu1
